description: Warehouse forklift agent modeled on Section 2.3: reaches the middle shelf and carries heavy items. These are scenario capabilities, not a claim of implemented forklift hardware control. Limits: Middle-shelf retrieval and heavy-item transport; no top-shelf or flight capability is advertised. Capability does not grant access: protected resources require a valid, unrevoked permission for the authorized task interval. Executes simulated delivery through a gate into the secure zone using the shared deliver_to_safe_zone workflow, subject to SST access permissions and the stated shelf and payload limits.
name: Forklift Agent

skills.name: Reach middle shelf
skills.description: Model access to a middle-shelf storage location for retrieval.
examples: Retrieve an authorized target item from the middle shelf.

skills.name: Carry heavy items
examples: Carry an authorized heavy target item retrieved from the middle shelf.

skills.name: Deliver to secure zone through a gate
skills.description: Execute the simulated warehouse delivery workflow. Approach and retrieve an authorized item, carry it to the gate, request gate opening, traverse the open gate, and place the item in the secure zone. This skill includes gate traversal and delivery. It requires valid SST access to both the item and gate. The agent's shelf-reach and payload limits still apply.
examples: Retrieve a heavy target item from the middle shelf and deliver it to the secure zone through the gate.
